visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with grey-tinted hair and a white long-sleeve shirt sits on a light grey couch, holding a damp beige sweater. She smells the garment with a disgusted, frustrated facial expression, surrounded by a large, unorganized pile of laundry. (2) A man wearing a beige sweatshirt peeks from behind a dark door frame into the living room, smiling and pointing his finger upwards as if introducing a secret. (3) The man is shown kneeling on a tiled floor next to a white Roborock washing machine in a laundry room; bright yellow graphic rays emanate from him to emphasize the reveal. (4) The woman appears in the laundry room, looking at the new appliance with wide eyes and an open-mouthed expression of surprise and joy. (5) Close-up shots show the man's hand rotating the digital dial on the Roborock washing machine and pressing the touch screen to start a cycle. (6) A detailed shot shows the detergent drawer opening, with a thick yellow liquid being poured into the smart dispensing compartment. (7) Two young girls dance and spin around in a bright indoor setting, wearing clean white hoodies and sweaters, showcasing their fresh clothes. (8) A young girl sits at a dining table eating; a close-up shows a white shirt with brown food stains, followed by a split-screen showing the same shirt completely clean while the woman smiles in approval. (9) The woman holds and smells a soft pink knitted sweater and a green silk blouse, touching the fabric to demonstrate the gentleness of the drying process. (10) The man holds a black long-sleeved shirt toward the camera, pointing at the clean fabric to show the absence of lint or pet hair. (11) The man and woman stand together in a living room; the man holds a fan of Taiwanese banknotes while gesturing enthusiastically to discuss the product's value. (12) Finally, the man kneels by the washing machine, pulls out a dry white t-shirt, and gives a direct thumbs-up to the camera.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 衣服怎麼還沒乾啦. 吼~最討厭冬天洗衣服了啦. (2) [Slogan]: 送老婆一台新洗衣機. (3) [Subtitle]: 老公你買新的洗衣機哦? 對啊有了. Roborock H1 Neo 衣莉莎白洗脫烘. 妳洗衣機再也不用看天氣的臉色了. (4) [Variety]: 懶人必備! 25種智慧洗烘. 一鍵搞定 不用再煩惱怎麼選. 妳看這智慧洗劑投放 懶人操作超貼心的啦. (5) [Variety]: 洗得乾淨! 抗菌、特漬洗! 搭配雙重銀離子殺菌 你的陽台晾衣蚊蟲問題直接解決. 再來特別介紹一下這個 特漬洗模式. 咖啡漬、油漬 不用手洗 直接洗乾淨. (6) [Variety]: 分子篩技術、獨家黑科技. 它不是一般的烘乾技術哦 而是分子篩低溫烘乾 就像吹頭髮一樣 先吸水再烘乾 連羊毛、真絲 都可以安心洗烘. (7) [Variety]: 毛絮自清潔、免動手清理. 衣服上的毛屑很困擾你嗎? 有了 H1 Neo 不用再自己清毛屑 它會自動幫你清乾淨. (8) [Variety]: 高CP值! 真正的智慧洗烘. 市面上的熱泵洗烘機啊 又慢又貴 H1 Neo 洗烘一體 不傷衣、CP值又高 根本完勝. (9) [Slogan]: H1 Neo 衣莉莎白即洗即穿 真很好用 快去 roborocktw 官網下單吧.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a female voice exhibiting high vocal arousal and a frustrated, complaining tone over a bright, upbeat electronic pop background music track. (2) A sharp 'ding' sparkle sound effect triggers a new phase as a male voice enters with a loud, projecting, and excited delivery. (3) Male narration takes over with high clarity and a friendly professional tone; digital 'blip' and 'click' sound effects are mixed in as the washing machine dial is operated. (4) A distinct 'glug' sound effect of liquid detergent being poured is synchronized with the upbeat tempo of the music. (5) Child giggles and background chatter are mixed under the male narration, followed by a 'whoosh' transition sound effect as the scene shifts. (6) The male narrator's speech rate remains fast and enthusiastic while describing technical features, accompanied by the crisp sound of fabric rustling as clothes are handled. (7) A 'pop' comedy sound effect emphasizes the visual stain removal reveal; the BGM maintains a steady, energetic rhythm. (8) The sound of paper money being fanned out (rapid rustling) is clearly audible as the narrator discusses price efficiency. (9) A final rising 'stinger' synth sound effect concludes the audio track as the male voice makes a final enthusiastic call to action.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Problem -> Solution -> Feature Demonstration -> Cost Benefit -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a promotional advertisement for the Roborock H1 Neo washing machine. It begins by establishing a common household frustration (wet laundry in winter) and introduces the product as the ultimate solution. It systematically highlights technical advantages like smart dosing, stain removal, and fabric protection through a series of energetic family-oriented scenarios to build consumer trust and desire.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct product demonstration, brand logo prominently displayed, and a verbal/text call to action to visit the official website.
